headline: Fish Audio has launched Drama 3, an AI voice model that lets creators direct how a voice performs and repair a single word without regenerating the audio around it.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a useful product step for synthetic voice, but a preview release with company claims only.
importance_line: People who produce audiobooks, dubbed video, games and audio dramas could fix a mistake in synthetic speech without redoing a whole recording, but Unite.AI calls these potential benefits and notes the release offers no independent test of how well single-word repairs hold up.
summary: Unite.AI reports that Fish Audio, a voice-AI company that says it serves more than 15 million users, announced Drama 3 on 13 Oct 2026, a text-to-speech model whose delivery can be steered with plain-language directions such as a whisper or a shift from calm to panic, that can generate multi-speaker scenes in one pass, and that can regenerate a selected word or segment while keeping the audio around it. The company's claims have not been independently tested, the model is still labelled a preview, and Fish Audio itself advises that results vary between takes.
